# ibee_vpc_subnet (Resource)

A subnet inside an IBEE VPC. The public API has no subnet update operation, so every change replaces the subnet. Settings that are not configured are not sent and the API's defaults apply. Import as vpc_id/subnet_id.

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py; edit schema descriptions in Go. -->

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ibee_vpc_subnet" "app" {
  vpc_id = "VPC_ID"
  name   = "app"
  cidr   = "10.0.1.0/24"
}
```

## Schema

| Attribute | Type | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `auto_cidr` | `bool` | Optional, Defaulted | Sent as auto_cidr with create. |
| `cidr` | `string` | Optional, Defaulted | IPv4 CIDR. Omit to let the API assign one. |
| `dns` | `list(string)` | Optional, Defaulted | DNS resolver addresses advertised to subnet members. |
| `gateway` | `string` | Read-only | Gateway IPv4 address returned by the API. |
| `id` | `string` | Read-only |  |
| `name` | `string` | Required |  |
| `prefix_length` | `number` | Optional, Defaulted | Prefix length for an automatically assigned CIDR. |
| `vpc_id` | `string` | Required |  |

## Import

Import an existing resource with the identifier shown. Review the imported plan before applying; creation-only settings and local deletion permissions cannot always be reconstructed from the API.

```shell
terraform import ibee_vpc_subnet.app 'VPC_ID/SUBNET_ID'
```
